quotes.text: Set the `bizum_payments` capability to `active` on your platform account, and on any connected accounts you want to enable Bizum for.
The Bizum payments capability stays in a `pending` state until compliance with Bizum onboarding requirements is verified.
You must submit the requested information within 40 calendar days. Bizum provides a decision within 90 calendar days.

findings: The paired 2026-05-06 capture says Connect No and lacks Connect in product support; the 2026-11-07 capture says Connect Yes, adds it to product support, and documents active bizum_payments on both platform and each accepting connected account. Descriptor defaults follow charge type: direct uses connected account; destination and separate charges/transfers use platform unless on_behalf_of selects connected account. This is the sole central substantive change (old raw lines 36-38, 85-93, 178-197; new raw lines 37-39, 86-95, 189-209; source lines 13, 17).

Bizum remains a Spain-customer, EUR-only, customer-initiated real-time payment using the Bizum-registered phone number and bank-app approval. Merchant-location list has 28 countries, but listed merchant location is distinct from customer location and settlement/presentment currency. Recurring and manual capture remain No; Checkout setup/subscription mode and Express Checkout Element remain unsupported (old raw lines 8-50, 52-93, 187-197; new raw lines 9-51, 53-95, 211-221; source lines 17-19).

The 0.50-5,000 EUR charge range, restricted categories, company tax ID or VAT ID versus individual personal ID, business_type and pending-until-verification capability status are unchanged. Requesting capability does not mean it is active or that a payment succeeded (old raw lines 110-152; new raw lines 112-154; source lines 21-23, 29).

Disputes and refunds retain the old state boundaries: 120-day customer dispute initiation, 40-calendar-day evidence submission, 90-day Bizum decision, held disputed amount, 395-day full/partial refund window, asynchronous refunds up to five minutes, and final succeeded/failed Refund webhook/object status. A submitted refund or evidence packet is not final outcome (old raw lines 154-185; new raw lines 156-187; source lines 25-27).

The source's 'longest of any reviewed payment method' claims are comparisons not established by either Bizum raw; keep them out of an authority claim or verify against the defined comparison set. This is a baseline summary accuracy issue separate from the Connect delta (source lines 13, 25, 27; old raw lines 154-185; new raw lines 156-187).
substantive_changes: Connect support changes from No to Yes, with new Connect product listing, bizum_payments capability requirement for platform and connected accounts, and charge-type/on_behalf_of descriptor routing (old raw lines 36-38, 85-93, 187-197; new raw lines 37-39, 86-95, 189-209).

The overview does not define a particular SDK/UI flow beyond linked Checkout and Elements routes; do not infer a client/server confirmation sequence or payment success from its product listing (new raw lines 86-110, 156-187).

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/bizum, the 2026-11-07 capture documents a Spain-customer, EUR-only, phone-number and bank-app-authorized real-time method, with no recurring or manual capture and Checkout setup/subscription mode and ECE exclusions (new raw lines 9-51, 53-95, 211-221). Access requires business identity details and business_type; capability stays pending until compliance verification, and a requested capability is not active acceptance or payment success (new raw lines 141-154). Disputes have 120-day initiation, 40-day merchant evidence and 90-day decision boundaries; refunds have a 395-day window and asynchronous final status (new raw lines 156-187). The paired old raw said No Connect (old raw lines 36-38), while new raw says Yes and requires bizum_payments active on platform and accepting connected accounts with charge-type descriptor rules (new raw lines 189-209). source-stripe-bizum.md still repeats No Connect and must distinguish the dated states (source lines 13, 17).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/bizum, the substantive change is Connect No in the 2026-05-06 capture versus Connect Yes with active platform/connected-account capability and descriptor rules in the 2026-11-07 capture (old raw lines 36-38, 85-93; new raw lines 37-39, 189-209). source-stripe-bizum.md and the Bizum concept must preserve the old claim as dated and warn reciprocally about the new one. The buyer-to-customer word change, Elements quickstart URL, heading/inline-code formatting and slightly reworded limits/dispute prose are presentation or navigation differences, with the same numeric and lifecycle facts (old raw lines 95-185; new raw lines 97-187). Both captures say EUR only despite boilerplate 'equivalent other supported currencies'; do not infer another currency. Checkout mode exclusions are UI-specific, capability pending is not active, and dispute evidence/refund submission is not final adjudication or refund success.
